entities.summary: Adolf Abrahamowicz was an Austro-Hungarian Armenian writer who wrote in the Polish language. He was a landowner, but lived of his life in Lviv. He worked with many directors and actors, especially with Ryszard Ruszkowski. His farce and slapstick was very popular in the Polish entertainment repertoire of the nineteenth century.
